semiconductor_relevance: High — Hyesung Technology specializes in the maintenance and repair of vacuum pumps critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Hyesung Tech Co., Ltd. is a comprehensive solution provider for vacuum pump services, focusing on the repair and maintenance of various vacuum pump brands used in semiconductor equipment. The company emphasizes customer service with real-time updates throughout the repair process and offers both repair services and sales of used pumps.
capabilities: Repair and maintenance of turbo pumps

regional_presence.China: Hyesung Tech partners with Shanghai Patorr Vac Tech Ltd. to provide local services.
